quote: “The good we secure for ourselves is precarious and uncertain, is floating in mid-air, until it is secured for all of us and incorporated into our common life.”
source: Jane Addams, Twenty Years at Hull-House, Chapter VI, The Subjective Necessity for Social Settlements (Macmillan, 1910)
